name: hpc-agent-antigravity
description: Standalone HPC Orchestrator Plugin: 19 packed skills spanning Cloud HPC Toolkit provisioning, GCE instance selection & flexibility, VM availability & quota checks, AlphaEvolve evolutionary optimization, domain HPC workloads (CAE, EDA, Weather/Climate, Structural Impact, Energy, Molecular Dynamics, Quant Finance), ParaView/VMD/WebGL 3D visualization, 30-day monitoring dashboards, and a 4h HPC Spend Monitor Sidecar. [Disclaimer: This work is for demo and experimental purpose only. Use at your own risk.]
suggestedPrompts: Open the HPC Spend Monitor (4h) sidecar to check our monthly HPC spend portion and set our monthly max budget
Run the HPC Cluster & Slurm Monitor skill to review our 30-day running instances, Slurm user jobs, and storage usage
Run the Google Cloud Batch Monitor skill to check active Batch nodes in use and per-user job durations over the last 30 days
